name: Unobstructed
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Buvtack
description: Allows you to seamlessly open chests, barrels, and other containers right through mounted signs and item frames. Prevents the struggle of finding that tiny gap just to access your storage
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
